## What is Electronics Reference?

Electronics Reference is a collection of **free **resources for people who are interested in the
***amazing ***field of electronics.

The idea behind Electronics Reference was initially based on one of the guiding tenets of the fabled
‘**Art of Electronics**‘ textbook – that electronics is a field that can be treated as an art. It
can be learned at many interdisciplinary levels to develop an intuitive skillset that allows us to
work with electronic systems at different levels.

Electronics Reference began as a standalone course on fundamental electronics and circuit analysis,
and has expanded in scope toward topics of greater complexity like programming, computing, and
hacking.

At its core, Electronics Reference is about embracing technology as a language that we can develop
fluency with. **We believe this will become increasingly important** as the use of computers and

## What is Electronics Reference?

Electronics Reference is a collection of **free **resources for people who are interested in the
***amazing ***field of electronics.

The idea behind Electronics Reference was initially based on one of the guiding tenets of the fabled
‘**Art of Electronics**‘ textbook – that electronics is a field that can be treated as an art. It
can be learned at many interdisciplinary levels to develop an intuitive skillset that allows us to
work with electronic systems at different levels.

Electronics Reference began as a standalone course on fundamental electronics and circuit analysis,
and has expanded in scope toward topics of greater complexity like programming, computing, and
hacking.

At its core, Electronics Reference is about embracing technology as a language that we can develop
fluency with. **We believe this will become increasingly important** as the use of computers and

В первую очередь сайт предназначен для тех, кто начинает осваивать радиоэлектронику, а если быть

  научиться паять и конструировать самоделки своими руками.

# Радиоэлектроника для начинающих | Go-Radio.ru

Давным-давно…, ещё задолго до появления всемирной паутины, юные радиолюбители начинали своё
знакомство с электроникой благодаря книгам.

Но сейчас, в эпоху цифровых технологий и интернета, информация стала доступной буквально на кончиках
пальцев.

Я предлагаю вам, посетителям сайта «Go-radio.ru», начать свой путь в радиоэлектронике со страниц
данного сайта. Возможно, свой путь в электронике вы начнёте именно отсюда [Смайл - Подмигивание].

## Для кого предназначен сайт?

В первую очередь сайт предназначен для тех, кто начинает осваивать радиоэлектронику, а если быть
точнее – для юных радиолюбителей. Несмотря на это, сайт будет полезен и начинающим радиомеханикам,
студентам профильных вузов и училищ, а также всем тем, чьё хобби – электроника.

Итак, что Вы здесь найдёте…
* [Раздел "Старт"][8] Раздел для тех, кто ни разу не держал в руках паяльник, но очень хочет
  научиться паять и конструировать самоделки своими руками.
* [Раздел "Мастерская"][9] Раздел для тех, кто не хочет бегать по мастерским, а производить ремонт
  электроники самостоятельно.
* [Раздел "О Компах"][10] Раздел для тех, кто хочет познать более углублённо компьютер. Как после
  вирусного "нашествия" сохранить важные файлы, настроить домашнюю беспроводную сеть, да и просто
  починить "мыша", который сломался в самый неподходящий момент.
* [Раздел "Технологии"][11] В разделе "Технологии" Вы узнаете о современных технологиях электроники
  начиная от устройства новейших электронных компонентов и заканчивая современными средствами
  беспроводных коммуникаций.

### "Горячая десятка" | Популярные страницы сайта
* [Маркировка конденсаторов.][12]
* [Электрическая схема скутера.][13]
* [Схема контроллера литий-ионного аккумулятора.][14]
* [Конструкция зарядного устройства от шуруповёрта.][15]
* [Диод Шоттки. Особенности и обозначение на схеме.][16]
* [Что такое децибел (дБ)? Перевод из децибел в разы.][17]
* [Как соединять динамики?][18]
* [Как проверить конденсатор? Проверка конденсаторов цифровым мультиметром.][19]
* [Таблица ESR. Таблица допустимого и реального ESR (Эквивалентного последовательного
  сопротивления).][20]

Рейтинг составлен на основе данных за январь-июнь 2018 года.

[Раздел "Радиоэлектроника для начинающих"] [Радиоэлектроника для начинающих][21]

Для тех, кто ни разу не держал в руках паяльник, но очень хочет научиться паять и конструировать
самоделки своими руками.
[Раздел "Самостоятельный ремонт радиоэлектроники"] [Ремонт радиоэлектроники][22]

Для тех, кто не хочет бегать по мастерским, а ремонтировать электронику самостоятельно.
[Раздел "Просто о компьютерах"] [Работа с компьютером][23]

Для тех, кто хочет более углублённо познать компьютер. Настройка, восстановление, ремонт.
[Раздел "Технологии радиоэлектроники"] [Технологии радиоэлектроники][24]

Устройство и принцип работы современных электронных компонентов и приборов. Как работает прибор
ночного видения? Что такое пироэлектрики? Об этом Вы узнаете в разделе "Технологии".
[Раздел "Секреты ремонта автомагнитол"] [Секреты ремонта автомагнитол][25]

В данном разделе будут размещаться материалы, посвящённые теме ремонта автомагнитол. Здесь не будет
простого перебора конкретных неисправностей автомагнитол и CD/MP3-проигрывателей, а будут
рассматриваться основные аспекты самостоятельного ремонта автомагнитол.

Зная методологию поиска и устранения типичных неисправностей автомагнитол можно за редким
исключением восстановить работоспособность практически любой автомагнитолы даже не имея под рукой
принципиальной схемы и сервисной документации на конкретную модель автомобильного проигрывателя.

## **Professional Chip Resistors Manufacturer-HK Resistors**

[修饰-1]
Hong Kong Resistors Manufactory (Asia) Company Limited was established in 1985 as a Hong Kong-funded
resistor manufacturing company. Headquartered in Hong Kong, it has three factories in mainland
China, including Dongguan in Guangdong Province, Yiyang in Hunan Province and Nanchong In Sichuan
Province. The main product outputs of these plants are [SMD resistors][74] and the[ through hole
type resistors][75]. In order to meet the requirements of customers on other electronic components,
we also provide other electronic component supporting services; for example: [chip capacitors][76],
[electrolytic capacitors][77], [metal film capacitors][78] and [ceramic capacitors][79]. All types
of resistors and supporting electronic components produced by our factory are in line with EU RoHS
environmental protection requirements and have obtained internationally recognized SGS laboratory
material analysis reports.

After a long day at work or after a full week of caring for your home and children, it is time for
relaxation, your **hobby hour**. Hobbies will keep you occupied between work and family, and
cultivating a good hobby may have calming or helpful therapeutic side effects.

Hobbies are practiced for enjoyment and interest, rather than financial reward. Engaging in a hobby
can lead to acquiring substantial knowledge, skill and experience, but the most important gain is
your personal fulfillment.

What are hobbies for some people are professions for others: a programmer may enjoy [guitar
playing][4] as a hobby, while a professional musician might enjoy programming. But remember that
Linux began as a student's hobby.

A hobby doesn't have to cost a fortune to be enjoyable. Activities like [sport fishing][5] can be
maintained for a reasonable amount spent on equipment and travel, paper-making requires little more
than junk mail and a blender, and so on.

[Eurasian Hobby] **The history of the word "hobby":**
Falconry was a very popular pastime in the Middle Ages and the "Eurasian Hobby" was perhaps the most
popular bird used for this sport.
An alternative origin for the word can be accounted for a recreational animal called hobby - a type
of small ambling or pacing horse. A hobby-horse was a wooden toy made to be ridden just like the
real hobby. From this came the expression "to ride one's hobby-horse", meaning "to follow your
favorite pastime", and in turn, hobby in the modern sense of recreation.

There are hobbies for every personality, lifestyle and budget. Popular hobbies often involve
**collecting items** like coins, stamps, baseball cards, **working with your hands** like sewing,
embroidery or performing an **outdoor activity** like climbing, hiking or bird watching.

Creating something **useful** or making a **handcrafted item** for decoration can be both practical
and profitable. Acting, play writing, poetry, playing an instrument, collecting music tapes, or
writing song lyrics are all good ways to spend a quality time.

**Radio controlled** model cars, airplanes, helicopters or boats have opened up a wide spread,
interesting recreational activity. Previously sold as toys, today's RC devices are expanding rapidly
in complexity and variety.

Board and card games like chess, checkers or mah-jongg are a great way to stimulate your mind and
meet new people.

If you are looking for a hobby to fill your leisure time, visit our page about today's most [common
hobbies][29]. This is not a complete list, but it may help you get started.

We hope you'll find a hobby that you feel is right for you. Just remember that the most important
thing is that you have fun with whatever hobby you choose!

After a long day at work or after a full week of caring for your home and children, it is time for
relaxation, your **hobby hour**. Hobbies will keep you occupied between work and family, and
cultivating a good hobby may have calming or helpful therapeutic side effects.

Hobbies are practiced for enjoyment and interest, rather than financial reward. Engaging in a hobby
can lead to acquiring substantial knowledge, skill and experience, but the most important gain is
your personal fulfillment.

What are hobbies for some people are professions for others: a programmer may enjoy [guitar
playing][4] as a hobby, while a professional musician might enjoy programming. But remember that
Linux began as a student's hobby.

A hobby doesn't have to cost a fortune to be enjoyable. Activities like [sport fishing][5] can be
maintained for a reasonable amount spent on equipment and travel, paper-making requires little more
than junk mail and a blender, and so on.

[Eurasian Hobby] **The history of the word "hobby":**
Falconry was a very popular pastime in the Middle Ages and the "Eurasian Hobby" was perhaps the most
popular bird used for this sport.
An alternative origin for the word can be accounted for a recreational animal called hobby - a type
of small ambling or pacing horse. A hobby-horse was a wooden toy made to be ridden just like the
real hobby. From this came the expression "to ride one's hobby-horse", meaning "to follow your
favorite pastime", and in turn, hobby in the modern sense of recreation.

[Metal detecting]

[**Metal Detecting**][6]
[Cheap metal detectors][7]
[Bounty Hunter Tracker][8]
[Garrett ACE 150][9]
[Bounty Hunter Junior][10]
[Bounty Hunter Fast Tracker][11]
[Terminology][12]

[Electronics]

[Computer microphones][16]
[Metal detectors][17]

[Visit our Guitar section]

[Guitar effects][24]

[Sport Fishing]

[**Sport Fishing**][25]
[Angling regulations (UK)][26]
[Sport fishing in Australia][27]
[Fishing magazines][28]

There are hobbies for every personality, lifestyle and budget. Popular hobbies often involve
**collecting items** like coins, stamps, baseball cards, **working with your hands** like sewing,
embroidery or performing an **outdoor activity** like climbing, hiking or bird watching.

Creating something **useful** or making a **handcrafted item** for decoration can be both practical
and profitable. Acting, play writing, poetry, playing an instrument, collecting music tapes, or
writing song lyrics are all good ways to spend a quality time.

**Radio controlled** model cars, airplanes, helicopters or boats have opened up a wide spread,
interesting recreational activity. Previously sold as toys, today's RC devices are expanding rapidly
in complexity and variety.

Board and card games like chess, checkers or mah-jongg are a great way to stimulate your mind and
meet new people.

If you are looking for a hobby to fill your leisure time, visit our page about today's most [common
hobbies][29]. This is not a complete list, but it may help you get started.

We hope you'll find a hobby that you feel is right for you. Just remember that the most important
thing is that you have fun with whatever hobby you choose!

# Empowering Businesses with
# Innovative Solutions

Om Electronic Corporation is a leading semiconductor distributor, providing a wide range of
electronic components to industries globally. As a trusted semiconductor supplier, we offer top
quality parts including ICs, passive components, sensors, and connectors, among others. We take
pride in being an authorized semiconductor distributor, ensuring that every component we supply is
authentic.

With over five decades of industry experience, Om Electronic Corporation has grown into a top
semiconductor supplier. Our role as an authorized semiconductor distributor ensures you get genuine
products every time.

## Company Overview

Human beings are on the road of electronic information construction, and PAGOODA has always been its
important sharer, creator and contributor. PAGOODA is committed to adapting to the various SMD
electronic components required by the global high-tech electronics industry. Over the past two
decades, having experienced reforms and innovations in the electronic age again and again, PAGOODA
supports your usual "accustomed" life. PAGOODA products continue to support the lives and social
activities of human beings all over the world in places where no one can see. Now and at this
moment, PAGOODA products are playing a full role in the "accustomed" life around you.     PAGOODA is
an integrated chip electronic component supplier leading the world with laminated ceramic
technology. Today, among the products that everyone comes into contact with daily, there are still
various electronic components of PAGOODA showing their talents. PAGOODA's products and technologies
are contributing to the realization of future applications, such as autonomous driving, renewable
energy, 5G communications, robotics, AR/VR, IoT drones, etc., thereby improving the daily lives of
people all over the world. In PAGOODA's three major markets: automotive, information and
communication technology, and industrial equipment and energy markets, these seven applications will
be the future growth areas. It is the mission of Pingshang people to contribute to the future of
electronic technology and social development by providing valuable products to the growth
market.Pingshang Technology was established in Hong Kong in March 1999, and the factory is
headquartered in Taiwan. With the development of high-tech electronic materials, Pingshang
Technology Co., Ltd. timely researched and developed chip capacitors (MLCC), chip resistors (Chip
Resistor), chip diodes ( Diodes, Transistors), chip tantalum capacitors (Tantalum Capacitors), chip
beads (Chip beads), etc. It is a service provider of large-scale electronic component distribution
for private, private, state-owned and foreign-funded electronic industries with self-support import
and export rights, based in mainland China.

# Supplier of a Full Range of Resistors

We are a Chinese resistor supplier capable of providing a full range of resistors. With ample spot
goods available for global supply, we have established warehouses in mainland China, Hong Kong,
Southeast Asia, Europe, Mexico, and Brazil. We strive to offer comprehensive resistor solutions to
clients worldwide.

Based on China's powerful manufacturing industry, we are able to offer a comprehensive range of
resistors, including precision, high-voltage, high-resistance, low-temperature coefficient,
high-power, high-current, miniaturized, and customized types. We cater to our customers' product
needs and ensure they obtain the resistors they desire.
Sourcing Solutions
We view ourselves as a partner, rather than just a supplier. Whether you're seeking a discontinued
component, aiming for cost savings, or facing difficulties due to extended lead times, we're here to
assist you. If we don't currently have the part you require in stock, our seasoned procurement team
will leverage our preferred supplier network to locate it for you.
Extensive warehouse distribution
We have warehouses in mainland China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, Europe, Mexico, and Brazil. Our
on-hand inventory guarantees 7x24-hour global shipment, striving to meet our customers' immediate
needs.
Getting the Right Components for Your Business
Our team, with over two decades of accumulated experience, consistently leverages our existing
inventory and extensive global supplier network. This enables us to shorten your procurement lead
times, reduce transaction costs, and offer high-quality resistors at highly competitive market
prices.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about sourcing electronic components

### Where can I buy hard-to-find or obsolete electronic components?

Seekcomp specializes in sourcing **hard-to-find, obsolete and long lead-time electronic components**
through our global network of 500+ suppliers. Submit an RFQ with your part number and required
quantity — our team typically responds within 24 hours with pricing and availability. We cover IC
chips, passives, connectors, power management and more.

### How do I get a quote for electronic components?

You can [submit an RFQ][257] with your part number, quantity and target delivery date — we respond
within 24 hours. For multi-line **BOM (Bill of Materials) orders**, [upload your BOM file][258] and
we will provide a consolidated quote covering all components. No minimum order quantity.

### Can I order electronic components in small quantities?

Yes. Seekcomp supports orders of all sizes — from single-unit **prototype samples** to large
production-volume orders. There is no minimum order quantity restriction for standard in-stock
items. We serve R&D engineers, startup companies and large-scale manufacturers alike.

### How do you ensure electronic components are genuine and not counterfeit?

Every component supplied by Seekcomp undergoes strict **quality control inspection** — including
visual inspection, electrical testing, X-ray analysis and documentation verification. We source from
reputable global suppliers and franchised channels. All parts are **100% authentic, traceable and
RoHS-compliant**.

### Do you ship electronic components worldwide?

Yes. Seekcomp ships to **100+ countries worldwide** via major international freight carriers.
Express shipping options are available for urgent orders. We handle all export documentation,
including commercial invoices, packing lists and certificates of origin as required.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about sourcing electronic components

### Where can I buy hard-to-find or obsolete electronic components?

Seekcomp specializes in sourcing **hard-to-find, obsolete and long lead-time electronic components**
through our global network of 500+ suppliers. Submit an RFQ with your part number and required
quantity — our team typically responds within 24 hours with pricing and availability. We cover IC
chips, passives, connectors, power management and more.

### How do I get a quote for electronic components?

You can [submit an RFQ][257] with your part number, quantity and target delivery date — we respond
within 24 hours. For multi-line **BOM (Bill of Materials) orders**, [upload your BOM file][258] and
we will provide a consolidated quote covering all components. No minimum order quantity.

### Can I order electronic components in small quantities?

Yes. Seekcomp supports orders of all sizes — from single-unit **prototype samples** to large
production-volume orders. There is no minimum order quantity restriction for standard in-stock
items. We serve R&D engineers, startup companies and large-scale manufacturers alike.

### How do you ensure electronic components are genuine and not counterfeit?

Every component supplied by Seekcomp undergoes strict **quality control inspection** — including
visual inspection, electrical testing, X-ray analysis and documentation verification. We source from
reputable global suppliers and franchised channels. All parts are **100% authentic, traceable and
RoHS-compliant**.

### Do you ship electronic components worldwide?

Yes. Seekcomp ships to **100+ countries worldwide** via major international freight carriers.
Express shipping options are available for urgent orders. We handle all export documentation,
including commercial invoices, packing lists and certificates of origin as required.

## Company Overview

Shenzhen Yezhan Electronics Co., Ltd is a sophisticated manufacturer which highly professional
performance on manufacturing, designing and researching of all kinds of Micro Resistors, Milliohm
Resistors and other Resistors. It has strong product R & D and manufacturing ability & very good
after-sale service. Since founded in 2005, our advanced production lines, precise equipments, strict
quality control process and experienced engineers team are capable to fulfill the toughest
requirement from customers worldwide. Our Products & Services Resistor Manufacturing: milliohm
resistors and shunt resistors, including high-precision welding feet current sense resistors,
high-precision power sense resistors, presser foot sense resistors, jump wire resistors and bare
sense resistors. OEM & ODM capacity: 6400-square-meter factory, 130 skilled workers, 15 QC staffs, 8
R & D engineers, 10 sales elites, 6 product lines, full richly detected testing equipments &
machines. Certificates: CE, RoHS, REACH, IEC compliance. ISO9001: 2000 certification obtained.
Location and traffic route: Located in Longhua New Area, Shenzhen City, P.R.China, It is about 40
minutes ride by car from Shenzhen Airport or borders between Hong Kong and Shenzhen, It is 90
minutes route by high-speed railway from Guangzhou Nan (Canton Fair).
